overview: The National Scholarship Portal (NSP) is a one-stop solution for various scholarship schemes launched by Union Government, State Governments, and Union Territories. It enables student application, processing, sanction, and disbursal of scholarships directly into beneficiaries' accounts through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). The portal aims to provide a simplified, mission-oriented, accountable, responsive, and transparent (SMART) system for faster and effective disposal of scholarship applications and delivery of funds without leakages.
objectives: Ensure timely disbursement of Scholarships to students
Provide a common portal for various Scholarships schemes of Central and State Governments
Create a transparent database of scholars
Harmonisation of different Scholarships schemes & norms
Simplified process for the students: All scholarships information available under one umbrella and single integrated application for all scholarships
Improved transparency: System suggests the schemes for which a student is eligible and duplicates can be reduced to the maximum extent
Helps in standardisation: Master data for Institutions and courses at all India level and scholarships processing
Serves as a decision support system (DSS) for Ministries and departments
Comprehensive MIS System to facilitate monitoring every stage of Scholarships distribution
eligibility: Eligibility varies by specific scholarship scheme hosted on NSP. General requirements include being a student, meeting domicile criteria, income limits (often Rs. 8 lakh per annum or less), academic merit, and enrollment in recognized institutions. Specific schemes may target categories such as orphans, wards of parents died due to Covid-19, wards of Armed Forces martyred in action, specially-abled students, girl students, SC/ST/OBC, minorities, and others. Aadhaar or Aadhaar Enrolment ID is mandatory for most schemes. One Time Registration (OTR) is required to apply for scholarships on NSP from AY 2024-25 onwards.
benefits: Financial support through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts. Non-financial benefits include simplified application process via single integrated form, eligibility suggestions by the system, reduced duplication, transparency in processing, standardisation of data, and access to a common portal for multiple central and state scholarship schemes. Additional benefits include OTR generation for lifelong use, availability at Common Service Centres (CSCs), and helpline support.
financial_support: Financial support varies by scheme and is disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) through PFMS gateway into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts. Examples include: PM-USP CSSS provides academic fee (up to Rs. 1.25 Lakh for professional courses) and maintenance allowance (Rs. 1.00 Lakh per annum); AICTE Swanath Scholarship provides Rs. 50,000 per annum; Pragati and Saksham Scholarships provide Rs. 50,000 per annum; PMSS provides ₹3,000/month for girls and ₹2,500/month for boys. The total charges for OTR generation and application filing at CSCs is fixed at Rs 30.00 per candidate.
application_process: 1. Generate One Time Registration (OTR) using Aadhaar/Aadhaar Enrollment ID via NSP OTR app or portal. 2. Login to NSP using OTR ID and password. 3. Check eligibility for scholarship schemes using the eligibility checker. 4. Select desired scheme and fill the online application form. 5. Upload required documents (e.g., mark sheets, income certificate, category certificate, bonafide certificate). 6. Submit application before the deadline. 7. Application undergoes verification at institute, district/state, and ministry levels. 8. After approval, scholarship amount is disbursed via DBT to Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
required_documents: Aadhaar number or Aadhaar Enrolment ID (EID)
Mark sheets of qualifying examination (10th, 12th, etc.)
Income certificate issued by competent authority
Death certificate (for orphan or Covid-19 related schemes)
Shaheed certificate (for wards of martyred personnel)
deadlines: Varies by scheme. For AY 2026-27, student application open from 1st June 2026, closing date for student application is 31-10-2026, institute verification closing date is 15-11-2026, and L2 verification closing date is 30/11/2026. Some schemes have rolling basis or specific windows; refer to individual scheme guidelines on NSP.
implementing_agency: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India
contact_details: Email: helpdesk[at]nsp[dot]gov[dot]in | Helpline: 0120 - 6619540 (8:00 AM to 8:00 PM on all days, except government holidays) | Toll free Number: 1800 118 111
caveats: Aadhaar or Aadhaar Enrolment ID is mandatory for most scholarship schemes.
One Time Registration (OTR) is required to apply for scholarships from AY 2024-25 onwards.
Correction/editing is not allowed after application submission.
Incomplete or false information may lead to rejection.
Scholarship amount must be refunded if received from other sources or if eligibility conditions are violated.
Benefits are discontinued if student fails to get promoted or drops out.
OTR generation requires Aadhaar-linked mobile number and successful face authentication.
Services at Common Service Centres (CSCs) incur a fixed charge of Rs 30.00 per candidate.
